# php-excel-helper

> Modern, secure and fluent PHP library to read and write Excel/spreadsheet files (xlsx, xls, ods, csv) using intuitive array configurations or fluent builders. Built on top of PhpSpreadsheet.

## Package Info
- **Composer Package:** `phatnt93/php-excel-helper`
- **PHP Requirements:** PHP ^8.1
- **Root Namespace:** `ExcelHelper\`
- **Core Facade:** `ExcelHelper\Excel`

## Quick Reference

### Read Excel / CSV to Array
```php
use ExcelHelper\Excel;

$result = Excel::read('file.xlsx', [
    'header_row' => 1,
    'start_row'  => 2,
    'columns'    => [
        ['header' => 'ID',     'key' => 'id'],
        ['header' => 'Name',   'key' => 'name'],
        ['header' => 'Salary', 'key' => 'salary', 'type' => 'number'],
        ['header' => 'Date',   'key' => 'date',   'type' => 'date'],
    ],
]);

$rows = $result->rows();     // list<array<string, mixed>>
$errors = $result->errors(); // list<RowError>
```

### Write Array to Excel / CSV
```php
use ExcelHelper\Excel;

Excel::write([
    'title' => 'REPORT',
    'columns' => [
        'id'     => 'ID',
        'name'   => ['header' => 'Full Name', 'width' => 28],
        'salary' => ['header' => 'Salary', 'type' => 'number', 'format' => '#,##0'],
    ],
    'data' => [
        ['id' => '001', 'name' => 'Alice', 'salary' => 1500],
    ],
    'totals' => ['salary' => 'sum'],
    'zebra' => true,
])->save('report.xlsx');
```

### Process Huge Files in Chunks
```php
use ExcelHelper\Excel;
use ExcelHelper\Reader\ChunkContext;

$summary = Excel::chunk('huge.xlsx', ['columns' => ['A' => 'name']], 1000,
    function (array $chunkRows, ChunkContext $ctx): void {
        // Process each batch of 1000 rows
    }
);
```

### Fluent Builders
```php
// Read
$res = Excel::reader('file.xlsx')
    ->headerRow(1)
    ->column('A', 'code')
    ->read();

// Write
Excel::writer()
    ->title('List')
    ->column('name', 'Name')
    ->data($items)
    ->save('file.xlsx');
```

## Available Types
- `string`: keeps leading zeros, normalizes scientific float notation.
- `int`: casts integers, rejects fractional floats.
- `float` / `number`: standard floating point number.
- `decimal`: string preserving exact decimal precision.
- `bool`: true/false, 1/0, yes/no, đúng/sai.
- `date`: Excel serial conversion (1900 & 1904) or string parsing.
- `datetime`: full date and time.
- `time`: time fraction or time string.
- `auto`: safe type inference; strings always written as text (formula injection guard).
- `percent`: 0.15 = 15%, format `0.00%`.
- `money`: currency number formatting `#,##0`.
- `formula`: calculated formulas starting with `=`.
- `link`: hyperlinks with safe scheme whitelist (http, https, mailto).
- `raw`: uncast PhpSpreadsheet value.
- `formatted`: cell formatted string display (read-only).

For full options schema, see `llms-full.txt` or `README.md`.
